paragraphs.text: The Shell of the Last Kappa is a legendary artifact on the plane of Kamigawa during the time of the Kami War .

The Shell of the Last Kappa was a magical relic of considerable magic power displayed within a shrine. It appeared as a large reflective turtle shell. Its name stemmed from the fact that Kappa were thought to have gone extinct before the Kami War though this was proved to be false, as centuries later, the kappa were seen during the Neon Dynasty .
